metadata.description: Official marketplace for agent-doe-engine, a design-of-experiments engine for tuning AI agents

plugins.name: agent-doe-engine
plugins.description: A design-of-experiments engine for tuning AI agents. Test many input variables in few runs (2-7 factors in <=8 runs, 8-11 in a 12-run screening), measure every objective on every run, and select the best trade-off across competing metrics by weighted scalarization, Derringer-Suich desirability, or Pareto frontier. Falls back to a single-variable autoresearch keep/revert loop. numpy-only, host-agnostic (Claude Code + Codex manifests).
